## Code Review

This pull request optimizes the extraction of issue metadata in `.agents/scripts/pulse-merge.sh` by consolidating multiple `jq` calls into a single execution using a record separator. Feedback suggests improving compatibility with older `jq` versions by replacing the optional chaining operator with a more portable idiom and ensuring that error output is not suppressed for better debugging.

## Code Review

This pull request introduces a canonical report component taxonomy and evidence badge model, consisting of a new JSON configuration file and comprehensive documentation. The changes establish a structured contract for report agents and renderers. Review feedback recommends enhancing the JSON schema by adding enums for effort and impact to ensure cross-component consistency. Additionally, it is suggested to update the verification commands to use npx --yes instead of bunx for better portability across environments.

This pull request introduces the `_reports/` data plane for managing generated report artifacts, including a new contract specification in `.agents/reports/outputs.md`, updates to the repository layout policy, and corresponding `.gitignore` rules. It also adds `_config` and `tsconfig.json` to the layout policy configuration. Review feedback suggests adding `_config/` to the architecture documentation for consistency and correcting the alphabetical sorting of the `_config` entry within the policy configuration file.

## Code Review

This pull request introduces two new subagent tools, design-md-from-links.md and report-presentation.md, to automate design system generation from external links and provide styling guidance for professional reports. Existing design documentation was updated to integrate these tools into the overall workflow. Review feedback correctly identified opportunities to improve the print CSS in report-presentation.md by ensuring CSS variable naming consistency with design tokens and refining link selectors to exclude internal anchors.

## Code Review

This pull request introduces a comprehensive framework for AI-search optimization, featuring a new report template, a weighted scoring model, and a tactic matrix for various page types. These tools are integrated into existing workflows to standardize evidence tracking via source IDs and per-engine visibility reporting. Reviewer feedback focused on maintaining documentation consistency, specifically regarding relative file paths, UK English spelling, alignment between scoring formulas and priority bands, and table header casing.

The CHANGELOG.md was also updated to document new features, maintenance tasks, and bug fixes. Feedback was provided to consolidate redundant maintenance entries in the changelog to improve readability.

This pull request introduces a comprehensive reporting framework for subagents, including a main reports agent and specialized routing for business, development, marketing, and SEO/GEO domains. It also establishes contracts for citations, exporters, and routine handoffs to ensure evidence-backed and reproducible reporting. A critical issue was identified regarding a missing reference file, `reports/outputs.md`, which is cited across multiple new documents but not included in the changes.

## Code Review

This pull request introduces a report rendering system that converts Markdown or JSON into portable HTML reports with features like sticky tables of contents and evidence badges. The implementation includes a Python helper, a Bash wrapper, documentation, and a test suite. Feedback on the Python script identifies several issues: a potential index error due to unchecked arguments, incorrect handling of multi-line Markdown paragraphs, and a crash when processing JSON arrays. Additionally, improvements were suggested for HTML table semantics to use proper header tags.

Approved after refactoring the renderer into focused helper modules and verifying local tests plus green CI/qlty gates.

## Code Review

This pull request enhances the robustness of GitHub API interactions and health dashboard generation. Key changes include handling empty rate limit responses in the REST fallback logic, implementing numeric validation for PR and issue counts, and introducing timeouts and a 30-repository limit for cross-repo summaries to prevent dashboard stalls. Review feedback suggests refining the regex for issue number extraction to prevent capturing log messages, simplifying numeric validation into concise one-liners, and replacing the hardcoded repository limit with a named constant accompanied by a warning log.

## Code Review

This pull request implements a comprehensive enhancement to the report rendering system, introducing a template-driven architecture that utilizes `DESIGN.md` brand tokens for consistent styling. Key technical updates include a rewritten Markdown parser supporting advanced components like stats strips and action panels, integrated Mermaid and LaTeX rendering, and automated action prompt generation. The update also includes an extensive library of brand-specific design systems and improved documentation for report exporters and handoff routines. Review feedback highlighted several areas for improvement in the parser's robustness, specifically regarding the handling of escaped pipe characters in tables, logic errors in the Mermaid SVG generator, and the fragility of the custom YAML-like token parser.

## Code Review

This pull request implements issue state tracking and filtering across the pulse prefetch and caching scripts to ensure only open issues are processed. It also introduces a label cleanup utility to remove terminal dispatch labels from closed or merged issues, preventing stale data from interfering with dispatch scans. Feedback suggests refining the label removal logic to handle cases where labels are already missing, ensuring accurate success counters in logs, and maintaining consistency in the use of new sweep-mode constants.

## Code Review

This pull request replaces hardcoded sweep modes with a constant variable in pulse-prefetch-fetch.sh and refactors the label cleanup process in shared-dispatch-label-cleanup.sh to verify label existence before removal. Feedback focuses on improving shell script safety and performance, specifically by ensuring proper exit code propagation for set -e compatibility, replacing inefficient nested loops with Bash pattern matching, and refactoring functions to minimize redundant API calls by passing pre-fetched data.

## Code Review

This pull request introduces the `_append_service_interruption_exhausted_metric` function to improve diagnostic reporting when service-interruption budgets are exceeded, alongside updates to failure evidence derivation and new unit tests. Review feedback highlights a scope issue where the `_metric_kill_reason` is not correctly preserved across function calls, potentially losing valuable diagnostic data. The reviewer recommends capturing this variable in a shared scope and suggests adopting a safer shell scripting pattern for local variable declarations to ensure consistent exit code handling.

## Code Review

This pull request modularizes the report rendering logic by extracting block, code, component, diagram, enhancement, and heading handlers into separate files. It also refactors the main helper and style parsing scripts for improved maintainability. Review feedback suggests making table detection more flexible regarding whitespace, relaxing the hyphen requirement for table separators to align with GFM standards, and updating Mermaid node extraction to support chained arrows.
